BODY BACK DOOR GLASS
INSTALLATION
Adhesive 1. CLEAN AND SHAPE CONTACT SURFACE OF BODY
(a) Using a knife, cut away any rough areas on the body.
HINT:
Leave the adhesive on the body as much as possible.
(b) Clean the cutting surface of the adhesive with a shop rag
saturated in cleaner.
HINT:
Even if all the adhesive has been removed, clean the body.
2. CLEAN REMOVED GLASS
(a) Place marks for installing new clips to the glass.
(b) Remove the damaged dips and dams.
(c) Using a scraper, remove the adhesive sticking to the
glass.
(d) Clean the glass with cleaner.
NOTICE:
Do not touch the glass after cleaning It.
